_comment: JSON Schema for every tool the risk agent can call. This file is the contract between agent/agent_tools.py and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — keep them in sync. Each tool has a 'money_impact' field used by the permission handler to decide default caution even before policy_config is consulted.

tools.name: get_risk_assessment
tools.description: Fetch (or compute, if not cached) the current risk score and reason codes for a payment. Read-only, never gated.

tools.name: hold_payment
tools.description: Place a payment on hold pending review. Does not refund or capture — reversible. Gated by policy_config rules for action_type=hold_payment.

reason.description: Human-readable justification, logged verbatim to agent_actions.agent_reasoning

tools.name: release_payment
tools.description: Release a previously held payment back to normal processing. Gated by policy_config rules for action_type=release_payment.

tools.name: draft_dispute_evidence
tools.description: Draft (but never submit) an evidence package for a chargeback dispute, using payment metadata and evidence templates. Always auto-allowed — drafting has no money impact, only submission does.

confidence.description: Agent's own confidence that this evidence will win the dispute

tools.name: submit_dispute_evidence
tools.description: Submit drafted evidence to Razorpay's Disputes API to contest a chargeback. IRREVERSIBLE and reputationally sensitive — always gated, regardless of risk score, per policy_config rule 'submit_evidence_gate'.

evidence.description: The evidence object, normally the output of draft_dispute_evidence after human review

tools.name: accept_dispute
tools.description: Concede a dispute (merchant does not contest, funds stay deducted). IRREVERSIBLE and always requires a human — policy_config rule 'accept_dispute_gate' is autonomy_tier=never_auto, meaning the agent may only ever RECOMMEND this action.

status.description: Note: 'accepted' is never a valid direct output — see money_impact

tools.name: notify_merchant
tools.description: Send an informational message to the merchant (e.g. WhatsApp/email summary). No money impact, always allowed.
